rag.text:
Test: TC-5945 — SPM - Strategic areas - Interacting with tables on OKRs tab
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-519 Strategic Areas
Labels: spm-paulina-tc

Steps:
1. Navigate to OKR module of ROOT (Main) box
   Expected: OKR module is displayed
2. Click on Add button
   Expected: Following options are displayed:

* Create objective
* Create strategic theme
* Link to box (grayed out)
3. Click Create Strategic Theme
   Expected: New Strategic theme modal is displayed
4. Type strategicThemeName, select period and click Create
   Data: strategicThemeName: TC-5945

period: Y2026
   Expected: Strategic Theme is created and Tree view is displayed

Plus button is displayed next to Strategic Theme
5. Click on Plus button next to Strategic Theme, add newObjective
   Data: newObjective: TC-5943 A
   Expected: New Objective TC-5943 A is created under Strategic Theme TC-5943.
6. Click on Plus button next to Strategic Theme, add newObjective
   Data: newObjective: TC-5945 B
   Expected: New Objective TC-5945 B is created under Strategic Theme TC-5945.
7. Click on Plus button next to TC-5945 A objective, add keyResult
   Data: keyResult: TC-5945 C
   Expected: New Key Result TC-5945 C is created under Objective TC-5945 A
8. Click on Plus button next to TC-5945 A objective, add keyResult
   Data: keyResult: TC-5945 D
   Expected: New Key Result TC-5945 C is created under Objective TC-5945 A.
9. Click on Plus button next to TC-5945 B objective, add keyResult
   Data: keyResult: TC-5888 E
   Expected: New Key Result TC-5945 E is created under Objective TC-5945 B.
10. Click Finish & go back
   Expected: Strategic Theme TC-5945 is displayed on the list with expand button next to it
11. Click Strategic Areas on the left panel (above Settings)
   Expected: List of Strategic themes is displayed
12. Click on strategicThemeName
   Data: strategicThemeName: TC-5945
   Expected: OKRs tab is displayed with following OKRs:

* Strategic Theme: TC-5945
* 2 Objectives: TC-5945 A, TC-5945 B
* 3 Key results: TC-5945 C, TC-5945 D, TC-5945 E

Widgets on the left shows

* Strategic Theme: 1
* Objectives: 2
* Key results: 3
13. Hover over columnName and resize
   Data: columnName: OKR Name
   Expected: Column is resized
14. Hover over columnName and resize
   Data: columnName: Initatives
   Expected: Column Initatives is resized
15. Hover over columnName and click on Sort button
   Data: columnName: OKR Name
   Expected: Disable sorting button appeared
Sorting arrow direction is downwards

OKRs in the list are sorted:

* Strategic Theme TC-5945
* Objective TC-5945 B
* Key Result TC-5945 E
* Objective TC-5945 A
* Key Result TC-5945 D
* Key Result TC-5945 C
16. Click on Sorting button again
   Expected: Disable sorting button appeared

Sorting button arrow changed its direction: upwards

OKRs in the list are sorted:

* Strategic Theme TC-5945
* Objective TC-5945 A
* Key Result TC-5945 C
* Key Result TC-5945 D
* Objective TC-5945 B
* Key Result TC-5945 E
17. Click on Sorting button of columnName
   Data: columnName: Status
   Expected: Sorting by OKR name is disabled and Sorting by status is enabled
